services.name: Massage
services.desc: Think you don’t know how to meditate? Think again… Experienced meditator that wants to take it to the next level? Experience a guided mediation within a massage treatment and experience the easiest and most natural way to slip into trance and harness the intuition and deep relaxation that flow from alpha and theta brainwaves. Massage therapy with muscle testing that is used to identify any trapped emotions in the musculoskeletal system that may be contributing to pain and dysfunction. Muscle testing allows one to get direct feedback from the subconscious mind through simple resistance exercises. Attention and Intention to the trapped emotion(s) allows processing and letting go. blurb: A Vital Touch Massage Therapy offers registered massage therapy combined with mind-body techniques such as guided imagery meditation, hypnosis, and somatic emotional release. Treatments focus on physical relaxation, mental calmness, and emotional well-being, integrating advanced manual therapy with neuroscience and psychoneuroimmunology. Specialized services include pregnancy massage, children and teens massage therapy, and past life regression therapy.
